The *Ambadāyakattheraapadāna* is a verse narrative found within the *Therāpadāna* division of the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya, designated as text Tha-Ap 70 [SuttaCentral]. The text has been translated into five modern languages according to SuttaCentral records [SuttaCentral].

No external parallels in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan traditions are recorded on SuttaCentral or identified in automated cross-language searches [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. Within the Pali canon and its exegetical corpus, DharmaNexus detects significant text reuse [DharmaNexus]. The commentary on the *Theragāthā* (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, first section) shares 14 matching textual segments with this apadāna, including verses corresponding to segments §8.3–9.3 [DharmaNexus]. Additionally, the formulaic verses located in segments §8.3–11.1 are shared extensively with other apadānas focused on gift-giving, including the *Isimuggadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 187), *Piyālaphaladāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 142), *Ārāmadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 309), and *Ālambaṇadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 223) [DharmaNexus].
